2607.08257.title: MentalHospital: A Virtual Environment for Evaluating Psychiatric Clinical Encounters
2607.08257.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on isolated psychiatric tasks, including dialogue, diagnosis, and treatment planning, yet existing benchmarks rarely simulate complete psychiatric clinical encounters. We introduce $\textbf{MentalHospital}$, a virtual evaluation environment for LLM-based psychiatric clinical encounters. MentalHospital instantiates the Subjective Interviewing, Objective Examination, Diagnostic Assessment, and Treatment Planning (S.O.A.P.) workflow, using skill-augmented standardized patients constructed from 1,193 de-identified psychiatric electronic health record (EHR) cases spanning all major ICD-11 categories and 76 disorders. Each encounter is assessed through a dual-track protocol that combines objective comparison against EHR-derived references with subjective assessment of clinical process quality. To scale specialist judgment, we develop $\textbf{MentalEval}$, five domain-specific evaluators covering communication empathy, interviewing professionalism, clinical-note quality, diagnostic rigor, and treatment appropriateness, trained with rubric-grounded SFT and expert-guided DPO. Survey responses from 22 clinicians support MentalHospital's clinical fidelity (3.88/5), while MentalEval achieves strong expert alignment with an average QWK of 0.944. Benchmarking shows that even the strongest LLM trails clinicians by 37.28 percentage points in objective psychiatric competence, with mental status assessment as a key bottleneck.
2607.08257.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在孤立的精神病學任務上表現出強大的性能，包括對話、診斷和治療計劃，但現有的基準很少模擬完整的精神病學臨床接觸。我們引入了 $\textbf{MentalHospital}$，這是一個基於LLM的精神病學臨床接觸的虛擬評估環境。MentalHospital 實現了主觀訪談、客觀檢查、診斷評估和治療計劃（S.O.A.P.）工作流程，使用從1,193個去識別化的精神病電子健康記錄（EHR）案例中構建的增強技能標準化病人，涵蓋所有主要的ICD-11類別和76種疾病。每次接觸都通過一個雙軌協議進行評估，該協議結合了與EHR衍生參考的客觀比較和對臨床過程質量的主觀評估。為了擴大專家判斷，我們開發了 $\textbf{MentalEval}$，這是一個涵蓋溝通同理心、訪談專業性、臨床筆記質量、診斷嚴謹性和治療適當性的五個領域專用評估工具，並使用基於評分標準的SFT和專家指導的DPO進行訓練。來自22位臨床醫生的調查回應支持MentalHospital的臨床忠實度（3.88/5），而MentalEval在專家對齊方面表現強勁，平均QWK為0.944。基準測試顯示，即使是最強的LLM在客觀精神病學能力上也落後於臨床醫生37.28個百分點，其中心理狀態評估是一個關鍵瓶頸。
